title.en: The housing pressure behind the EU average
title.zh: 欧盟住房平均数背后的负担

summary.en: Eurostat’s November 26 housing publication reports a 19% average cost share for 2025, alongside a 36% share for the lower-income group. Different denominators explain why an average can conceal pressure.
summary.zh: 欧盟统计局11月26日发布住房数据：2025年住房成本平均占可支配收入19%，低收入组则为36%。读懂分母，才能看见平均数背后的压力。
